description: Get details of a specific security configuration scan result. Most controls in a result usually passed; set status to "failed" to get only the controls that need fixing.

manifest_name.description: Name of the configuration manifest to get details for (get this from the list_configuration_security_scan_manifests tool)

min_severity.description: Only return controls at or above this severity: Critical, High, Medium or Low (optional)

namespace.description: Namespace of the manifest, as returned by list_configuration_security_scan_manifests (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

status.description: Only return controls with these statuses, comma-separated: failed, passed, skipped (optional; by default every control is returned)

name: get_configuration_security_scan_manifest

description: Discover available security configuration scan results at workload level (this returns a list of manifests, not the scan results themselves, to get the scan results, use the get_configuration_security_scan_manifest tool)

continue.description: Optional Kubernetes continuation token for pagination

namespace.description: Namespace to list (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL). A workload's scan is stored in the workload's namespace; scans of cluster-scoped resources are in Kubescape's own namespace (usually kubescape)

name: list_configuration_security_scan_manifests

description: List the packages in an image SBOM (name, version, type, purl, licenses), sorted by name. Returns a page of results (see limit/offset) with the total count. Use name or package_type to look for specific packages.

limit.description: Maximum number of packages to return (optional, default 100, maximum 500)

name.description: Only packages whose name contains this text, case-insensitive (optional)

namespace.description: Namespace of the SBOM (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

offset.description: Number of packages to skip; pass the previous response's next_offset to get the next page (optional, default 0)

package_type.description: Only packages of this type, for example deb, rpm, apk, npm, python, go-module, java-archive (optional)

sbom_name.description: Name of the SBOM, as returned by list_sboms

name: list_sbom_packages

description: Discover the image SBOMs stored in the cluster, without their content. Use list_sbom_packages to read the packages of one. Kubescape stores them in its own namespace (usually kubescape).

continue.description: Optional Kubernetes continuation token for pagination

namespace.description: Namespace to list (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

name: list_sboms

description: List the vulnerabilities in a given manifest, one entry per CVE and affected package, most severe first. Returns a page of results (see limit/offset) with the total count; long text fields are left out unless include_details is true.

fixable_only.description: Only return vulnerabilities that have a fixed version (optional, default false)

include_details.description: Include description, CVSS, URLs, advisories and data source for each entry (optional, default false; makes the response much larger)

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (optional, default 100, maximum 500)

manifest_name.description: Name of the manifest to list vulnerabilities from

min_severity.description: Minimum severity to include: Critical, High, Medium, Low, Negligible (optional; by default every severity, including unclassified ones, is returned)

namespace.description: Namespace of the manifest (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

offset.description: Number of entries to skip; pass the previous response's next_offset to get the next page (optional, default 0)

name: list_vulnerabilities_in_manifest

description: Discover available vulnerability manifests at image and workload levels. Kubescape stores them in its own namespace (usually kubescape).

continue.description: Optional Kubernetes continuation token for pagination

level.description: Type of vulnerability manifests to list

namespace.description: Namespace to list (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

name: list_vulnerability_manifests

description: List all vulnerability matches for a given CVE in a given manifest

cve_id.description: ID of the CVE to list matches for

manifest_name.description: Name of the manifest to list vulnerabilities from

namespace.description: Namespace of the manifest (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

name: list_vulnerability_matches_for_cve
